heldout_exclusion.why: The reference is for taxon lookup. Day 10 evaluates taxon assignment on the held-out splits; a query that is itself in the reference returns a 100% self-hit and measures nothing. dev+test sequences (and long records whose build_dataset chunks are in them) are excluded; train sequences stay. Rebuild when processed/ is rebuilt - the sha256 values here show which splits this build excluded.
